courses.title: La psychologie du yoga, la voie vers une santé mentale rayonnante
courses.description: Two Saturday-afternoon workshops at the Geneva centre on Raja Yoga as a psychology of the mind, drawn from Patanjali's Yoga Sutras: how thoughts, habits and conditioning shape experience, the kleshas as roots of suffering, and practical methods for concentration and steadiness. Each workshop can be booked alone or as a full day with the morning asana and pranayama class and a vegetarian lunch.

courses.title: Yoga prénatal (prenatal yoga class)
courses.description: A weekly Sivananda class for pregnant women on Tuesday evenings at the Geneva centre, teaching variations of the postures suited to pregnancy. Women can join from the twelfth week without previous yoga experience; the centre asks them to consult their doctor before starting.

courses.title: Yoga doux / séniors (gentle yoga class)
courses.description: A slower, gentle Sivananda class built on simple postures and on releasing tension. It suits beginners, older students, people with reduced mobility and anyone coming back to practice after a break, and needs no advance booking.
